fields.label: Search listing preference
fields.description: Which listing a search result shows when a company trades on several venues: primary (its primary market, the default), EU (an EU/EEA venue when it has one) or US (a US exchange when it has one). A typed ticker, symbol or venue still wins.

fields.label: Source order
fields.description: Your preferred data sources, first choice first, separated by commas: plugin ids, provider names or common names, for example 'eodhd, coingecko, edgar'. One list for every kind of data; a source that does not cover an instrument is passed over. Leave empty for Pythia's default order: free sources first, so adding a key never changes the source by itself.

fields.label: Markets overview cards
fields.description: The subjects the Markets page shows as cards, in order, separated by commas or spaces: subject IDs such as index:pythia:sp500, future:pythia:cl, fx:pythia:EURUSD or a listing's ID from its page. Leave empty for Pythia's global default.

fields.label: Markets watchlist
fields.description: The subjects the Markets page's watchlist shows, separated by commas or spaces: any subject IDs, such as a listing's or a crypto asset's ID from its page. Leave empty for Pythia's example list.
